purpose: Universal Studio Director v7.0 — 10 Structural Video Format Modes (F1..F10), 3 Execution Lanes (lane_a_native, lane_b_web_plates, lane_c_hyperframes), 14 Native-Frame Micro-Bridges, ASL/A-Roll Envelopes, and 10x8 Industry Compatibility Matrix.

lane_a_native.label: Lane A — Pure FilmCraft Native wgpu Timeline (8V + 8A)
lane_a_native.engine: FilmCraft 0.20.1+ native .fcproj + C² Bezier Camera + RVM V3 Subject Sandwich + native graphic_text
lane_a_native.best_for: Talking-head authority, emotional storytelling, clinical before/after, salon/skincare macro, and clean spatial VFX

lane_b_web_plates.label: Lane B — FilmCraft Master + Deterministic Web/Canvas Motion Plates
lane_b_web_plates.engine: FilmCraft .fcproj + dviet_motion_canvas_engine.py / Playwright UI & KPI cards (sequential after RVM, max 2 Chrome workers)
lane_b_web_plates.best_for: Course funnels with 3D deliverables, SaaS UI walkthroughs, PAS/BAB E-com receipts, tactile Pros/Cons scorecards, and Top-N listicles

lane_c_hyperframes.label: Lane C — Full Kinetic Motion Composition (HyperFrames / Code-Driven Stages -> .fcproj)
lane_c_hyperframes.engine: HyperFrames deterministic HTML5/GSAP/Canvas multi-scene plates compiled onto editable FilmCraft .fcproj tracks
lane_c_hyperframes.best_for: Faceless motion explainers, system architecture reels, and 0%-15% A-roll data/brand manifestos

clean_0f_hard_cut.spec: 0-frame crisp hard cut snapped onto speaker head-turn or hand-raise velocity peak

true_vocal_jcut_prelead.spec: Incoming clause voice leads visual cut by 140ms-850ms (target 250ms-550ms) pulling attention invisibly

acoustic_lcut_room_tail.spec: Outgoing voice decay or ambient room tone trails beneath incoming B-roll cutaway

concentric_geometric_match_cut.spec: 0-frame affine-locked circle/rect focal match cut (delta_center <= 2.0%, delta_r <= 6.0%)

polarity_canvas_snap_1f.spec: 1-frame full-screen polarity inversion between Dark Obsidian (#081C15/#111111) and Light Paper/Porcelain (#EEF4EA/#FAFAFA)

c2_velocity_push_handoff.spec: Continuous C² Bezier scale push-in across cut boundary eliminating dead frame-0 camera holds

whip_pan_directional_330.spec: Directional blur whip-pan at shutter_angle=330 deg across spatial location or step changes

whip_zoom_optical_bridge.spec: Fast optical zoom ramp bridging wide A-roll into macro product/UI detail

rvm_foreground_wipe_pass.spec: RVM subject or foreground object pass-by masking background plate swap on V2/V3

split_diopter_50_50_slide.spec: Dual-panel 50/50 or 16:9 card slide comparing Before/After, Pros/Cons, or Speaker/UI

flash_halation_2f_pop.spec: Subtle 2-frame neutral/film exposure pop (automatically vetoed when warm_film_burn_veto == true)

iris_mask_expand_stage.spec: 1x -> 24x geometric mask expansion transitioning from A-roll into full-screen motion canvas

bgm_vacuum_drop_reentry.spec: >=0.50s -inf dB music stop vacuum (35ms pre-fade) before thesis punchline + beat-1 drop re-entry

tactile_asmr_foley_pivot.spec: Raw diegetic transient (pipette clink, box unseal, shutter click, brush sweep) motivating macro insert cut

expert_talking_head.label: F1 — Talking Head Chuyên Gia & Manifesto (@__dviet Dual-Rail Authority)
expert_talking_head.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Enforce cranial_exclusion_band [hair_top_y - 48, chin_y + 32]; route Hero/Lead strictly into upper_editorial_stage or chest_tactile_rail (>=20% clean breathing frames).

pas_bab_ecom_conversion.label: F2 — Quảng Cáo Chuyển Đổi PAS / BAB (Direct-Response Product Conversion)
pas_bab_ecom_conversion.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Protect macro_subject_bbox on zero-face product/bottle/swatch shots; enforce industry hard_veto_guards (skin_tone_hue_guard / warm_film_burn_veto).

tactile_review_testing.label: F3 — Review Thực Chiến & Chấm Điểm Xúc Giác (Tactile Testing, ASMR & Verdict)
tactile_review_testing.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Carve >=0.50s sensory ASMR break on unbox/swatch beat; lock Pros (#4ADE80) / Cons (#FF4D5E) / Score (#FACC15) outside macro_subject_bbox.

clinical_aesthetic_before_after.label: F4 — Case Study Lâm Sàng & Thẩm Mỹ Before/After (Clinical & Aesthetic Proof)
clinical_aesthetic_before_after.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Mandatory zero-ink lock over enamel_gum_bbox (CIE-Lab L*>72 & a*>16) and hand/nail/skin macro_subject_bbox; CRI-100 neutral white lock, warm_lut_veto & R200 claim_gate.

course_lead_magnet_funnel.label: F5 — Phễu Khóa Học, Coaching & Tặng Tài Liệu 3D (EdTech & Lead-Magnet Funnel)
course_lead_magnet_funnel.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Insert polarity/breathing reset every 12-15s; composite RVM comment rain behind speaker on V2/V3; render tangible 3D Workbook/Notion/Template mockup on CTA.

cinematic_vlog_storytelling.label: F6 — Vlog Điện Ảnh, Hậu Trường Xưởng & Tâm Sự (51% Emotion Craft Storytelling)
cinematic_vlog_storytelling.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Walter Murch 51% Emotion veto overrides rigid timers; preserve -34..-28 dBFS ambient room tone; forbid noisy UI/KPI checklists.

tutorial_ui_walkthrough.label: F7 — Hướng Dẫn Từng Bước & Quay Màn Hình 3D UI (Product/SaaS/Workflow Walkthrough)
tutorial_ui_walkthrough.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Use 50/50 split UI + PiP A-roll or isometric 3D glass browser stages; enforce CARD_TEXT_COLLISION = 0 over cursor/terminal focal regions.

fast_paced_listicle_top_n.label: F8 — Listicle Nhịp Nhanh Top-N / X Sai Lầm (Rapid Numbered Anchor & Step Progression)
fast_paced_listicle_top_n.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Deploy active-dim progressive step pills (S18b) or giant numeral stages; reset visual layout on every numbered item transition.

spatial_vfx_clone_storefront_tour.label: F9 — Spatial VFX, Clone Hook & Tour Không Gian Thực Tế (Storefront, Clinic, Salon & Property Tour)
spatial_vfx_clone_storefront_tour.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Anchor callouts to planar walls/architectural lines (planar_wall_tracking); RVM subject wipe transitions run sequentially prior to any plate render.

faceless_motion_explainer.label: F10 — Motion Graphics & Explainer Không Lộ Mặt (Faceless Kinetic Typography & System Film)
faceless_motion_explainer.spatial_safe_zone_contract: Zero talking-head dependency; obey MAX_ZONES <= 2, 1-Color-World Polarity Law, and 2-worker headless Chrome cap (< 4.5GB RAM).

profile_vetoes.purpose: Documents how profile-scoped atomics (presets/atomic_motion_library.json entries carrying profile_scope) are allowed or vetoed. This block is documentation only: enforcement lives in compile_and_verify.py (--profile default|dviet) and presets/profile_overrides.json.

default.note: Atomics whose profile_scope does not include the active profile are vetoed.

dviet.caps_source: each atomic's own max_duration and caps

veto_precedence: 1. Industry skin hard_veto_guards (warm_film_burn_veto on luxury_skincare, dental_clinic, beauty_spa) always win over profile dviet.
2. Without profile dviet, a profile-scoped atomic is a veto.
3. With profile dviet and no skin veto, the atomic is allowed within its max_duration and caps.

lifted_by_dviet.note: Only when no active skin carries warm_film_burn_veto.

profile_vetoes.implementation_owner: P1 (compile_and_verify.py, presets/profile_overrides.json); P3 provides data and docs only
